# WA8 · Khung · liên kết đồng bộ tài chính chờ kết nối

Group **WA · Khung & điều hướng** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`(app shell)`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/finance-bridge.js#status`
- The shell is drawn once by `clinic.js › shell(content)`: `.sidebar` (menu filtered by `PemaStaff.allowed(page)`), `.topbar` (breadcrumbs, demo account picker, global search, bell, reset), then the page body.
- `finance-bridge.js › status(text)` creates `<a id="finance-sync" href="../finance/">` (small blue text before the topbar controls) and updates its text after each `sync()`.
- Reached with every request to `http://127.0.0.1:4174/**` aborted: the `fetch(.../command/sync)` throws, so the link reads "Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại" (WA1 shows "Tài chính đã đồng bộ").
- Inventory note: finance-bridge.js puts a small link before the topbar controls. With the finance API unreachable it reads "Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại" (WA1 shows it as "Tài chính đã đồng bộ").
- Shown with account `owner-tam`; the screen is part of the shell or an overlay (no page key).
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"block":"http://127.0.0.1:4174/**"} → {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"wait":"#finance-sync"}; it must show "Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại".

## Business rules
- The account picker is a demo identity boundary, "NOT authentication or production RBAC" (header comment of `staff-context.js`).
- Three texts of the link: "Đang đồng bộ tài chính…" (request pending, WA9), "Tài chính đã đồng bộ" (OK, WA1), "Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại" (failed or unreachable). The ledger stays local until the API accepts it; the sync retries every 10 s and after each `pema-change`.

## Differences from the app design
- App H7 "Mất kết nối" is an error screen with a "Thử lại" button when the finance API is down; the web only changes the text of the small link in the topbar and keeps the page usable.
- Canvas: only the link text changes ("Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại"); the rest of the shell is WA1. Canvas: the skip link "Đến nội dung chính" is in the old DOM but visually hidden until focus, so this frame does not draw it (WA7 draws it focused); it is exempted through demo_data.

## Gotchas
- Role and page are kept in `sessionStorage` (`pema-staff`); a fresh browser context always starts as `owner-tam` unless `?staff=<id>` is in the URL.
- The link text changes while the page settles; the responsive probe ignores the three texts.
